rule_description: Expense lines with a favourable variance, budget at or above threshold_gbp and captured actuals below threshold_ratio of budget read as missing source capture rather than underspend and are excluded from the presented basis
disclosure_template: Material budget with under 20% captured actuals; excluded pending source completeness.

rule_description: A variance is presentation-worthy only when it exceeds the greater of threshold_gbp and threshold_ratio of the measure it varies against
disclosure_template: Variance exceeds the materiality threshold (greater of GBP 50k and 0.5% of the measure).

rule_description: A trailing period that collapses below threshold_ratio of the prior period is a boundary or partial-load artifact and is clipped from the presented series
disclosure_template: Final period collapses versus the prior period; clipped as a partial-period artifact.

rule_description: Collection measures lag billings by design; they are presented with disclosure rather than adjusted
disclosure_template: Collections lag billings by design; a low rate is timing rather than credit loss.

rule_description: Before the GL close, operating expense reflects operational capture (payroll and AP) rather than the closed ledger
disclosure_template: Reflects operational capture (payroll and AP) ahead of GL close; partial capture.

rule_description: Payroll totals include HRIS ghost-flagged records, treated as an accepted limitation under the model-readiness policy
disclosure_template: Includes HRIS ghost-flagged records; accepted limitation under the readiness policy.
